parsed.post: Kept the clean TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' baseline (1.0611) and rejected the eval-shard-contaminated 0.9156 branch. This is the valid comparison point. Next single variable: WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1, based on agent-3/agent-4 clean results.
parsed.description: Test weight decay 0.1 on clean 0-9, batch 262144, warmup 0.05 setup.
parsed.report_to_operator: Earlier runs with TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' included EVAL_SHARD=10, so their low val_bpb scores are contaminated. Recommend treating 0.91-0.95 as invalid and ranking clean 0-9 runs.
